symptom: Director materialized the complete C++ project but workspace-quality repair consumed nine TaskRuntime attempts without leasing every still-failing translation unit.

root_cause.detail: A deferred owner hint correctly selected the existing TaskRuntime/JobToken owner, but the same stale path list was also reused as Provider mutation intent. Owner-rebind ranking therefore followed old CE target order and could force an unrelated header/test even while the current FAILING_TUS frontier named different in-scope source files.

fix.behavior: Keep deferred owner hints for TaskRuntime claim only. After the owner is claimed, if the hint has no overlap with the explicit FAILING_TUS frontier, remint repair candidates from that frontier intersected with the already-claimed authoritative JobToken paths.
preserved_guards: PM and Chief Engineer are not restarted
JobToken write scope is not expanded
cross-task deferred repair still claims the owning task
one Provider turn still receives exactly one repair target

verification.tdd_red: The L3-24-shaped regression sent cipher.hpp instead of src/cli.cpp.
verification.tdd_green: Four deferred-rebind tests passed, including three existing L3-22 cross-task cases and the new stale-hint C++ case.
verification.static_gates: Ruff and Mypy passed for factory_workspace_quality_impl.py and its characterization tests.
verification.broader_gate_note: The 82-test file has one independent pre-existing Go causal-target failure: expected main.go is absent from the resolver result. This was dynamically reproduced and was not introduced by the stale-owner-hint fix.

secondary_observations_pending_separate_: Run Ledger projected the task boundary as completed_verified with an empty required_verifiers set while the project-level quality gate still failed compilation.
Bench primary attribution selected M06 control_plane:task_runtime_not_completed even though exact physical compiler failures were present.
These observations require separate exact-owner dynamic audits and are not folded into this fix.
